pages.title: No Monsters Up Here
pages.text: Nothing hostile spawns in the open overworld above $(l)y 40$(). Not at night, not in the dark, not in a cave mouth on a hillside.$(br2)This is deliberate. The surface is for animals, farms, villages and building. If you want to be afraid, you have to go looking for it.

pages.title: Three Exceptions
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Structures$() are exempt. A dungeon, fort, outpost or camp spawns monsters normally, at any depth. Dangerous places stay dangerous.$(br)$(li)$(l)Pillager patrols$() roam anywhere. They are not covered by the rule and never will be - they use a different spawning system entirely.$(br)$(li)$(l)The stalkers$() come when they want to. See the last page.

pages.title: Below y 40
pages.text: Between $(l)y 0$() and $(l)y 39$() monsters spawn normally, but no more than forty at once. Uneasy, not swarming.$(br2)Below $(l)y 0$() nothing is held back at all. The deep is meant to be the most dangerous place in the world, and it is.
